description: This file contains internal cryptographic function declarations and data structures related to TLS CBC padding, MAC handling, and ChaCha20-Poly1305 encryption, used within the BoringSSL library.

methods.name: EVP_tls_cbc_get_padding
methods.description: Determines padding from decrypted TLS CBC record.

methods.name: EVP_tls_cbc_remove_padding
methods.description: Removes padding from TLS CBC record.

methods.name: EVP_tls_cbc_copy_mac
methods.description: Copies MAC in constant time from TLS CBC record.

methods.name: EVP_tls_cbc_record_digest_supported
methods.description: Checks if a hash function is supported for digesting TLS records.

methods.name: EVP_sha1_final_with_secret_suffix
methods.description: Hashes data with secret suffix, used in unit tests.

methods.name: EVP_tls_cbc_digest_record
methods.description: Computes MAC of a decrypted TLS record.
